title: Supporting Literacy Assessment in West Africa: Using State-of-the-Art Speech Models to Evaluate Oral Reading Fluency
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models (Whisper V2 and wav2vec 2.0) for oral reading fluency assessment in educational settings, particularly in West Africa. While it discusses model bias against accents, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as part of its core research or findings.
